SELECT *, @rank_num := @rank_num + 1 AS rankNum FROM ( SELECT @rank_num := 0 ) r, ( SELECT ifnull( SUM( pay_money - IFNULL(cancel_money,0) ), 0 ) AS shopMoney, tor.shop_id , u.shop_name FROM tb_order tor left join goods_shop u on tor.shop_id = u.shop_id WHERE tor.shop_id IS NOT NULL and tor.status = 4
and date_format(tor.pay_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(tor.pay_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(tor.pay_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')
GROUP BY tor.shop_id ) a ORDER BY shopMoney DESC
